Why Notionary?
02 / 08

Students already share knowledge.
It doesn't just accumulate.

01

AI isn't trusted

Generic AI can hallucinate on course material and answer confidently without showing where the answer came from.

02

Powerful study systems take too much setup

Powerful setups exist, but most students shouldn't need CLI tools or hours of maintenance just to study.

03

Shared notes disappear

A useful note sent in WhatsApp in March is buried by May. Sharing today is transfer, not accumulation.

04

Slides aren't the lecture

Exam emphasis, intuition and verbal reminders often never make it onto the official slides.

Notionary turns scattered class knowledge into a maintained, connected module reference.

Built with Notion
N
04 / 08

How we built Notionary
on top of Notion.

We use Notion as the structured backend for the module — storing knowledge, preserving provenance and giving our AI a consistent source of truth.

01

Module database

We model the Cloud Computing module as structured Notion content rather than one long document.

Topic · Type · Week · Source
02

Relations & source links

Concept pages point back to the lecture, tutorial, assignment or paper they came from, so provenance stays attached.

Auto Scaling → Lecture 5
03

AI instruction layer

A Notion instructions page tells the AI how to use the module graph: ground answers, cite sources and expose conflicts.

answer → cite → flag conflict
04

Ingestion & updates

For the prototype, new material is ingested into the same structure so revised information updates the maintained module reference.

new source → structured update

Where this goes
06 / 08

From a study group
to the memory of a degree.

🏫

Maintained courses

Lecturers or module coordinators can eventually own and review the official course reference.

🗓

Knowledge across years

Carry useful concepts forward while preventing old deadlines and assessments becoming current.

🕸

Connected degree

Link concepts across modules to expose prerequisites and how new material builds on earlier learning.

🧠

Personal learning memory

Remember goals, attempts, misconceptions and progress privately across modules.

🎙

Capture more

Transcripts and board photos can preserve sourced lecture-only explanations.

Roadmap, not prototype claims. Today's planned demo uses manual ingestion and two explicit student profiles.
